Description:
I learned how to do this, while doing this.  It is a lot of work, so I hope the effort is appreciated.
[size=5]
[u]Good to Know[/u]
[/size]The Alt Versions of each character isn't lore friendly.  They are exaggerations of their assets, they are also more sexualized.  If you are not interested in that approach don't use an alt version.  However I do recommend them.  The reason is, my goal wasn't too make 6 gorgeous ladies it was instead to make 6 woman (and others) that all had their own unique presence mirroring their hair, clothing, and any other feature that was more apparent.  However these young ladies all have the power to be beautiful in their own way, they just need to know how to highlight their particular gifts.  Quite frankly that may be difficult with overalls, or Emily's ridiculous hair.  So I took these 6 completely different ladies with different body types and tried to make them as attractive as I could.  Abigail a little heavier doesn't mean she can't be beautiful for example, so I do recommend you go with them, unless of course you'd like to avoid risque.

[size=5][u]No Immediate Plans
[/u][/size] ﻿Alt Versions for the bachelors as a straight male I feel underqualified to approach a sexualized fashion with any justice, so sorry about that.
﻿Minor characters or deep characters, truly not even sure which ones are SVE and which ones are Vanilla.  Characters like Gus, the Mariner, Members of the Guild, etc.
﻿Some Major Characters that I'm not enthused about such as Willy, Pierre, Linus, Evelyn, and George.  To be honest I'd like to do everyone, but I have to draw some lines.
﻿The overworld sprites, if someone else wants to that'd be cool.

[size=5][u]Progress
[/u][/size]Well it seems like I'm not very along at all.  That isn't true at all.  I have every character in the works lists, face, expressions, and naked bodies down.  Yet hair is a headache, and after changing the art style of the hair 3 times I lose drive to complete the character.  So truly what is left is just hair, clothes, and posing, which is a lot, just letting people know I am further along then it seems.

The resolution is currently set to the natural 64x64 resolution.  This is kind of a post process, and much easier to do.  I have 2k resolution for the portraits, and full portrait sheets at 256x256.  Though I can resize them to 126x126 if its better for processing I don't really know what is best.  The point is Hi-Res looks a whole better, but since 1.6 Hi-Res portraits mod isn't working.  So I'll give access to them either way if you want to use portraiture or some other mod.  I don't use this mod myself so I don't know it works but I'll release it anyways.  The Hi-Res just looks so much better.
